answer: Who vouches for a new man when nobody in the town knows his face? The record does. Vintner press record with vintners attestation is the voucher the town trusts: eleven-year record, 6,000 tuns pressed, cellar accounts, annual review. Offer a borrowed inlet and the application dies on the table, the sponsor loses his deposit of twice the yearly dues and the hollow is handed to the parish chest, while the quill is filed away and shown to any challenger.
